chose: carry advanced recipe ids as sweepDid's own SweepResult (outcome + advancedRecipeIds), not as a field on RepoOutcome
over: adding advancedRecipeIds to RepoOutcome in types.ts
because: RepoOutcome is the sync-repo job's return value, which finalize folds via children() over Redis; types.ts's own header warns that shape must stay small and JSON-stable, and finalize has no use for the ids (only sync-repo's own enqueue loop, in-process, right after sweepDid returns) -- so growing RepoOutcome would be exactly the per-job-payload growth the plan explicitly avoided by enqueuing from sync-repo instead of finalize

chose: catch and log (error level) every ctx.enqueue failure per recipe id inside sync-repo's best-effort loop, rather than letting any of them propagate
over: letting a bad workflow/step name (ctx.enqueue's deliberate throw-on-typo) propagate and fail the sync-repo job
because: D3 says a failed enqueue must cost a repo nothing -- not its retries, not its other ids -- and the stale row already written by renderRecipe in the same transaction is the durable signal backfill will find regardless; a typo still surfaces loudly because it throws on every advanced id, on every repo, for the life of the bug, each one logged at error, which is louder in aggregate than one uncaught throw would be to a caller who does not catch it
